value.answer: Honest take: mostly overrated for the price. It's well made, third-party tested, and a lot of people like the taste and the convenience. But the independent reviews I found say several ingredients are underdosed, it's one of the pricier all-in-ones (about $89 a month on subscription, $112 one-time, depending on where you look), and I found no independent clinical evidence for its benefit claims. It only makes sense if it replaces several supplements you're already paying for.
